title: Worklist record
description: One record per exception invoice. It feeds the existing AP worklist (the ERP queue of parked or blocked invoices) with the evidence a person needs to decide. The agent writes status open. Only a person moves it to approved or rejected. In the BI staging table (agent_worklist) the nested money_impact fields flatten to money_impact_amount and money_impact_currency, exception_types joins with semicolons and evidence is stored as JSON text.

exception_types.description: Skill names, in the precedence order of policy/term-rules.yaml. The first entry is the primary exception.

evidence.description: Every figure the recommendation relies on, with where it came from.

source.description: erp: a fixed query result. invoice: a field or flag from the extraction. rules: a figure computed by the rules code.

query_id.description: For erp, a query id from integration/agent-tools.yaml. For invoice, the extraction field name or 'flags'. For rules, the rule key in policy/term-rules.yaml.

value.description: The figure or the quoted text. Untrusted text is stored as plain text, never as markup. Null when the value could not be read.

recommendation.description: The skill's fixed recommendation format, at most 120 words. Plain text.

money_impact.description: Both numbers behind the exception live in evidence; this is the money at stake. Currency is stated because PO values and invoices can carry different currencies.

amount.description: Signed. Positive when the company pays or loses more.

decided_by.description: A role or user id of the person who decided. Null while open.
